title: Fixing the market’s coffee listing
titleZh: 修正市集的咖啡攤資訊
passage:
Woman: I checked the street-market map on my phone. Finch Coffee has two dots now, one by the library and one by the theater. Anyone trying to buy a coffee could end up at the wrong stop.
Man: Both stops are real. The dates come through on the vendor's page, but the pins on the main map have no date labels. We can't add those this week. We can hide individual pins without taking the stops off the vendor's page.
Woman: Let's keep a pin where people can actually buy coffee today. Tourists also scan the square code on the printed market sign. Does it open the main map?
Man: Straight to the Finch page, actually. It works, but the stops are listed in the order they were entered. The library is first, even though the theater is today's.
Woman: Then move the stop that's open now to the top of that page. Keep the other date there. People planning a Saturday visit still need it.
passageZh:
女：我用手機看了市集地圖。雀鳥咖啡現在有兩個標記，一個在圖書館旁，另一個在劇院旁。想買咖啡的人可能會跑錯地點。
男：兩個地點都是真的。攤商頁面會顯示日期，但主地圖上的標記沒有日期標籤。我們這週還沒辦法加上去。不過，可以個別隱藏地圖標記，不用把營業地點從攤商頁面移除。
女：那就保留今天實際買得到咖啡的地點。遊客也會掃描市集印刷看板上的方形碼。掃了會開啟主地圖嗎？
男：其實是直接打開雀鳥咖啡的頁面。掃碼本身沒問題，但地點是按輸入順序排列的。圖書館排在第一個，雖然今天營業的是劇院那個點。
女：那就把目前營業的地點移到該頁面最上方。另一個日期要留在那裡。打算星期六來的人還需要那項資訊。
